description: Small curated traceability set for implemented HarvestOps behavior. This is not a historical product-manager approval record.

requirements.purpose: Operators need one scoped view of shipment service and production signals.
requirements.acceptance: Dashboard filters apply consistently to KPI cards, charts, and exceptions.
requirements.verification_method: SQL-backed service tests and browser dashboard smoke

requirements.purpose: Operators need safe shipment updates with bounded paging and concurrency protection.
requirements.acceptance: A permitted transition updates one selected shipment; stale versions are rejected and audited.
requirements.verification_method: SQL integration and browser workflow tests

requirements.purpose: Purchasing requests need a transactional approval workflow.
requirements.acceptance: Draft requests can be submitted; authorized approvers can decide; self-approval is prevented.

requirements.purpose: Identity and authorization boundaries must remain server-side.
requirements.acceptance: Demo and Entra roles are checked on routes and callbacks; invalid OAuth state is rejected.
requirements.verification_method: Security tests and controlled cross-site browser simulation

requirements.purpose: A release must be traceable to source, CI, and runtime evidence.
requirements.acceptance: The application exposes safe build identity and the Delivery & Quality page distinguishes runtime from GitHub evidence.
requirements.verification_method: Evidence service tests, browser rendering, and hosted CI
